verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity has a substantial API. It can create and track VerificationSessions, receive webhooks on status changes, and retrieve results using the secret key, and Stripe also documents a CLI and an MCP server for agent access. However, the docs say only "most" verification details are programmatically accessible. Manual review actions (status override, blocklisting), verification-flow setup and branding are described as dashboard tasks, with no evidence of API equivalents, so UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: API equivalents for review tools (override and blocklist), API management of verification flows and branding, an explicit parity statement, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).
